dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin pumps while memecoins dump - classic Elon chaos.  
Solaxy's 160% APY screams scam, yet degens dive in.  
Vitalik's preaching Layer-2, but we're all here for the FARTCOIN vibes.  
Crypto's a circus, and we're the clowns. 🚀

Dogecoin to the moon? Nah, just Elon's latest pump tease.  
Meanwhile, TRUMP coin's dumping harder than a bad NFT drop.  
Solana memecoins popping off, but half are scams.  
Web3 AI hype is real, but Vitalik's the only one not shilling.  
DYOR or get rekt, degens. 😎
